info.description: Fast port scanner for discovering open ports on hosts.

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: Hosts to scan ports for (comma-separated).

parameters.name: List
parameters.description: List of hosts to scan ports (file).

parameters.name: Exclude Hosts
parameters.description: Hosts to exclude from the scan (comma-separated).

parameters.name: Exclude File
parameters.description: List of hosts to exclude from scan (file).

parameters.name: Top Ports
parameters.description: Top ports to scan.

values.description: Scan full set of top ports.

parameters.name: Exclude Ports
parameters.description: Ports to exclude from scan (comma-separated).

parameters.name: Ports File
parameters.description: List of ports to scan (file).

parameters.name: Port Threshold
parameters.description: Port threshold to skip port scan for the host.

parameters.name: Exclude CDN
parameters.description: Skip full port scans for CDN/WAF and only scan ports 80 and 443.

parameters.name: Display CDN
parameters.description: Display CDN in use.

parameters.name: Threads
parameters.description: General internal worker threads.

parameters.name: Rate
parameters.description: Packets to send per second.

parameters.name: Update
parameters.description: Update naabu to latest version.

parameters.name: Disable Update Check
parameters.description: Disable automatic naabu update check.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: File to write output to.

parameters.name: JSON
parameters.description: Write output in JSON lines format.

parameters.name: CSV
parameters.description: Write output in CSV format.

parameters.name: Config
parameters.description: Path to the naabu configuration file.

parameters.name: Scan All IPs
parameters.description: Scan all the IPs associated with DNS record.

parameters.name: IP Version
parameters.description: IP version to scan of hostname.

parameters.name: Scan Type
parameters.description: Type of port scan.

parameters.name: Source IP
parameters.description: Source IP and port (x.x.x.x:yyy).

parameters.name: Interface List
parameters.description: List available interfaces and public IP.

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.description: Network interface to use for port scan.

parameters.name: Nmap
parameters.description: Invoke nmap scan on targets (deprecated).

parameters.name: Nmap CLI
parameters.description: Nmap command to run on found results.

parameters.name: Resolvers
parameters.description: List of custom resolver DNS resolution (comma separated or from file).

parameters.name: Proxy
parameters.description: Socks5 proxy (ip[:port] or fqdn[:port]).

parameters.name: Proxy Auth
parameters.description: Socks5 proxy authentication (username:password).

parameters.name: Resume
parameters.description: Resume scan using resume.cfg.

parameters.name: Stream
parameters.description: Stream mode (disables resume, nmap, verify, retries, shuffling, and more).

parameters.name: Passive
parameters.description: Display passive open ports using Shodan InternetDB API.

parameters.name: Input Read Timeout
parameters.description: Timeout on input read.

parameters.name: No Stdin
parameters.description: Disable stdin processing.

parameters.name: Host Discovery Only
parameters.description: Perform only host discovery.

parameters.name: Skip Host Discovery
parameters.description: Skip host discovery (deprecated, use -wn/-with-host-discovery instead).

parameters.name: With Host Discovery
parameters.description: Enable host discovery.

parameters.name: Probe TCP SYN
parameters.description: TCP SYN ping (host discovery needs to be enabled).

parameters.name: Probe TCP ACK
parameters.description: TCP ACK ping (host discovery needs to be enabled).

parameters.name: Probe ICMP Echo
parameters.description: ICMP echo request ping (host discovery needs to be enabled).

parameters.name: Probe ICMP Timestamp
parameters.description: ICMP timestamp request ping (host discovery needs to be enabled).

parameters.name: Probe ICMP Address Mask
parameters.description: ICMP address mask request ping (host discovery needs to be enabled).

parameters.name: ARP Ping
parameters.description: ARP ping (host discovery needs to be enabled).

parameters.name: ND Ping
parameters.description: IPv6 neighbor discovery ping (host discovery needs to be enabled).

parameters.name: Rev PTR
parameters.description: Reverse PTR lookup for input IPs.

parameters.name: Retries
parameters.description: Number of retries for the port scan.

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: Milliseconds to wait before timing out.

parameters.name: Warm Up Time
parameters.description: Time in seconds between scan phases.

parameters.name: Ping
parameters.description: Ping probes for verification of host.

parameters.name: Verify
parameters.description: Validate the ports again with TCP verification.

parameters.name: Health Check
parameters.description: Run diagnostic check up.

parameters.name: Debug
parameters.description: Display debugging information.

parameters.name: Verbose
parameters.description: Display verbose output.

parameters.name: No Color
parameters.description: Disable colors in CLI output.

parameters.name: Silent
parameters.description: Display only results in output.

parameters.name: Version
parameters.description: Display version of naabu.

parameters.name: Stats
parameters.description: Display stats of the running scan (deprecated).

parameters.name: Stats Interval
parameters.description: Number of seconds to wait between showing a statistics update (deprecated).

parameters.name: Metrics Port
parameters.description: Port to expose naabu metrics on.

parameters.name: Auth
parameters.description: Configure ProjectDiscovery Cloud (PDCP) API key.

parameters.name: Auth Config
parameters.description: Configure ProjectDiscovery Cloud (PDCP) API key credential file.

parameters.name: Dashboard
parameters.description: Upload or view output in ProjectDiscovery Cloud (PDCP) UI dashboard.

parameters.name: Team ID
parameters.description: Upload asset results to given team ID (optional).

parameters.name: Asset ID
parameters.description: Upload new assets to existing asset ID (optional).

parameters.name: Asset Name
parameters.description: Assets group name to set (optional).

parameters.name: Dashboard Upload
parameters.description: Upload naabu output file (jsonl) in ProjectDiscovery Cloud (PDCP) UI dashboard.

parameters.name: List Output Fields
parameters.description: List of fields to output (comma separated).

parameters.name: Exclude Output Fields
parameters.description: Exclude output fields based on a condition.

parameters.name: Connect Payload
parameters.description: Payload to send in CONNECT scans (optional).

parameters.name: Service Discovery
parameters.description: Service discovery.

parameters.name: Service Version
parameters.description: Service version.
